title: TAT-3012: Liquidation distance fallback for liq price <= 0
description: Verifies edit-margin modal displays liquidation distance correctly. Normal case (liq > 0) via live UI; edge case (liq <= 0 showing '--') covered by unit tests.

ac3-assert-liq-price-displayed.expression: (function(){ var el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="perps-position-liquidation-value"]'); return JSON.stringify({text: el ? el.textContent.trim() : 'NOT_FOUND', found: !!el}); })()

ac3-screenshot-liq-price.note: AC3: Market detail page showing liquidation price for current position (normal case, liq > 0)

ac1-assert-distance-valid.expression: (function(){ var el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="perps-edit-margin-liquidation-distance-value"]'); if (!el) return JSON.stringify({text:'NOT_FOUND',valid:false}); var text = el.textContent.trim(); var valid = text !== '0%' && text.length > 0; return JSON.stringify({text:text, valid:valid}); })()

ac1-screenshot-add-margin.note: AC1: Edit margin modal showing liquidation distance (normal case, liq > 0 shows valid %)

end-success.message: Liquidation distance display verified. Edge case (liq<=0 showing '--') covered by unit tests.
